name: scatter-chart
title: Scatter Chart
description: Shows how two measures relate, one point per row, grouped by color or sized as bubbles.

examples.name: basic
examples.title: Grouped points
examples.code:
import { ScatterChart } from '@advui/charts'

const projects = [
  { project: 'Mobile clinics', sector: 'Health', budget: 420, reached: 38 },
  { project: 'Maternal care', sector: 'Health', budget: 260, reached: 21 },
  { project: 'Vaccination drive', sector: 'Health', budget: 180, reached: 46 },
  { project: 'Water points', sector: 'WASH', budget: 310, reached: 52 },
  { project: 'Latrines', sector: 'WASH', budget: 150, reached: 19 },
  { project: 'Hygiene kits', sector: 'WASH', budget: 90, reached: 33 },
  { project: 'Temporary classrooms', sector: 'Education', budget: 240, reached: 12 },
  { project: 'Teacher stipends', sector: 'Education', budget: 120, reached: 9 },
  { project: 'Learning kits', sector: 'Education', budget: 70, reached: 15 },
]

export default function ScatterChartBasic() {
  return (
    <ScatterChart
      title="Budget and reach, by project"
      description="2026, thousands"
      data={projects}
      x="budget"
      y="reached"
      xLabel="Budget (USD)"
      yLabel="People reached"
      index="project"
      indexLabel="Project"
      category="sector"
      categoryLabel="Sector"
      startAtZero
      valueFormatter={(value, field) => (field === 'x' ? `$${value}K` : `${value}K`)}
    />
  )
}

examples.name: bubble
examples.title: Bubbles
examples.code:
import { ScatterChart } from '@advui/charts'

const townships = [
  { township: 'Hpakant', distance: 92, coverage: 41, people: 180000 },
  { township: 'Myitkyina', distance: 4, coverage: 86, people: 306000 },
  { township: 'Bhamo', distance: 18, coverage: 72, people: 154000 },
  { township: 'Mohnyin', distance: 64, coverage: 55, people: 213000 },
  { township: 'Putao', distance: 140, coverage: 28, people: 61000 },
  { township: 'Waingmaw', distance: 11, coverage: 79, people: 98000 },
  { township: 'Momauk', distance: 37, coverage: 63, people: 72000 },
]

export default function ScatterChartBubble() {
  return (
    <ScatterChart
      title="Coverage falls with distance"
      description="Kachin townships; bubble size is population"
      data={townships}
      x="distance"
      y="coverage"
      size="people"
      xLabel="Distance to a hub (km)"
      yLabel="Coverage (%)"
      sizeLabel="Population"
      index="township"
      indexLabel="Township"
      startAtZero
      valueFormatter={(value, field) =>
        field === 'x' ? `${value} km` : field === 'y' ? `${value}%` : value.toLocaleString('en-US')
      }
    />
  )
}
